title: AMP body: registry.federation_request
description: Request to establish federation between two registries.

registry_id.description: agent:// URI of the requesting registry
registry_id.title: Registry Id

trust_proof.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical proof payload (see federation_trust_proof_payload)
trust_proof.title: Trust Proof

audience.description: agent:// URI of the registry this request is addressed to (signed)
audience.title: Audience

issued_at.description: UTC issuance time of the proof (signed; freshness-checked)
issued_at.title: Issued At

x-amp-constraints: trust proof MUST verify per WIRE-BINDING section 12.16.1
